questions.question: What did Job desire to do regarding God?
options: Flee far from the presence of God
Curse God for all his suffering
Forget God and his ways entirely
Argue his case directly to God
questions.answer: Argue his case directly to God

questions.question: What did Job call his friends?
options: True prophets sent by God to warn him
Faithful comforters to him in his grief
Worthless physicians who whitewash with lies
Wise men who spoke to him nothing but the truth
questions.answer: Worthless physicians who whitewash with lies

questions.question: Job declared, 'Though he slay me, I will hope in him.'
Job said he would maintain his _____ to God's face.
Job asked God to withdraw His hand and not let His _____ frighten him.
